subtitle: Cross-check of 07/Oct/2026, third day of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): Polymarket at the confirmed reading of 07/Oct, 17:35 BRT, the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) final tally, the national polls from the eve of the first round and the press flow of 06 and 07/Oct.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 14.50% (vol USD 18.76M cumulative) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 07/Oct, 17:35 BRT, down 1.00pp against the confirmed reading of 06/Oct at 15:05 BRT, published in the previous update. COUNT: 45.16% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). POLL: the first second-round national polls come out on 08/Oct.
fortes: On the eve he led the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in Datafolha, 47% to 46%, in CNT/MDA, 47.3% to 43.1%, and in AtlasIntel, 47.6% to 47.4%, and was tied at 46% in PoderData.
🏆 Counting the closed contracts, his contract is still the one with the highest cumulative volume in the presidential book, USD 18.76M.
fracos: He stands at 14.50% in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 07/Oct, 17:35 BRT, and Flávio Bolsonaro's gap over him is 70.45pp.
He finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) 1.87 points behind Flávio Bolsonaro, with 45.16% of the valid votes against 47.03%.
In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 03/Oct government approval went from 46% to 44%, with 49% disapproval.
candidates.analise: Lula stands at 14.50% in the winner contract (vol USD 18.76M cumulative), confirmed reading of 07/Oct, 17:35 BRT, and falls 1.00pp against the confirmed reading of 06/Oct at 15:05 BRT, published in the previous update. 🗳️ He had 45.16% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), 1.87 points behind Flávio Bolsonaro. Lula said at a meeting with allies on 07/Oct that this year's campaign was the most disorganized he has taken part in since 1989 (Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo), called supporters to the streets on social media (G1) and pressed Flávio Bolsonaro for a position on ending the 6x1 work schedule (Agência Brasil). 📺 His campaign asked for the removal of Flávio Bolsonaro videos that associate him with Alexandre de Moraes and his son with the so-called Careca do [INSS](/en/glossary#inss), and the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) president denied the requests (G1 and Gazeta do Povo). The first second-round national polls are registered with the TSE for 08/Oct (Datafolha and PoderData), 09/Oct (AtlasIntel and Vox Brasil), 10/Oct (Ipespe) and 11/Oct (DataTrends). ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the endorsements or to the schedule: it measures the sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 84.95% (vol USD 17.91M cumulative) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 07/Oct, 17:35 BRT, up 0.65pp against the confirmed reading of 06/Oct at 15:05 BRT, published in the previous update. COUNT: 47.03% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). ENDORSEMENTS: Novo and ACM Neto on 07/Oct, after PP, União Brasil, Caiado, Zema and Temer.
fortes: He finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) ahead, with 47.03% of the valid votes against Lula's 45.16%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally.
He stands at 84.95% in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 07/Oct, 17:35 BRT.

He received the support of PP and União Brasil (06/Oct; G1, O Globo and Folha de S.Paulo), of Ronaldo Caiado (06/Oct; O Globo and VEJA) and of Novo and ACM Neto (07/Oct; G1, CartaCapital and Folha de S.Paulo), in addition to the vote declarations of Romeu Zema and Michel Temer.
On the eve he led the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), 44% to 42%, in Palver, 49% to 44%, in Futura, 48% to 45.1%, and in Gerp, 49% to 44%.

⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, second-round vote transfer favoured Flávio Bolsonaro among the voters of Romeu Zema (81%), Renan Santos (48%), Ronaldo Caiado (42%) and Augusto Cury (34%) (O Globo).
fracos: On the eve he trailed in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in Datafolha, CNT/MDA and AtlasIntel, and was tied in PoderData.

🏦 According to O Globo, the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) is investigating, in the inquiry into Daniel Vorcaro and Master's relationship with BRB, the bank's R$ 3.1 million financing to Flávio Bolsonaro for the purchase of a R$ 6 million mansion in Brasília; he says the transaction was legal, and the report comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution.

📰 Messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro's phone and published by Estadão on 24/Sep show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, in the days before Vorcaro's arrest, on 17 November 2025. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with its own sources close to the investigation.
candidates.analise: Flávio Bolsonaro stands at 84.95% in the winner contract (vol USD 17.91M cumulative), confirmed reading of 07/Oct, 17:35 BRT, and rises 0.65pp against the confirmed reading of 06/Oct at 15:05 BRT, published in the previous update. 🗳️ He had 47.03% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). 🤝 Novo declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 07/Oct, after Romeu Zema (G1 and CartaCapital), and ACM Neto announced support for him on the same day (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo). PP and União Brasil, which form the União Progressista federation, announced support on 06/Oct (G1, O Globo and Folha de S.Paulo), and Ronaldo Caiado declared support for him in Goiânia on the same day (O Globo and VEJA). According to VEJA and O Globo, Republicanos is expected to formalize support for Flávio Bolsonaro, with Tarcísio de Freitas in Brasília for that purpose, and VEJA reports that he is aiming to bring in Podemos. MDB is consulting its state branches: the majority favours a vote for Flávio Bolsonaro, according to Folha de S.Paulo, and the party is expected to remain neutral, according to O Globo. Solidariedade is not expected to back him, Paulinho da Força told Gazeta do Povo. Michelle Bolsonaro was with Flávio Bolsonaro at the PL caucus meeting on 07/Oct (Folha de S.Paulo, O Globo and Estadão). 🎙️ The broadcasters confirmed four second-round debates: Record on 11/Oct, at 21:00, a pool of 11 outlets with CNN Brasil, SBT and VEJA on 15/Oct, at 20:00, Band on 18/Oct, at 20:00, and TV Globo on 23/Oct (CartaCapital, VEJA and G1). The attendance of the two candidates is not yet confirmed, and according to Gazeta do Povo Flávio Bolsonaro is waiting for Lula's decision to confirm Band. ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the endorsements or to the schedule: it measures the sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): third place, with 2.89% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. PRICE: winner contract closed and resolved at zero, with USD 5.51M cumulative. [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): according to Agência Brasil, he talks of staying silent.
fortes: He finished third, with 2.89% of the valid votes, ahead of Renan Santos and Ronaldo Caiado.
The [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno)'s third-place book was resolved in his favour.
fracos: He is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and his contract in the winner book was resolved at zero.
On the eve the third-place book paid more for Renan Santos, 47.50%, and for Ronaldo Caiado, 30.00%, than for him, 23.70%.
candidates.analise: Augusto Cury finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in third, with 2.89% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally, and is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). His contract in the winner book was closed by Polymarket after the first round and resolved at zero, with USD 5.51M cumulative. The first round's third-place book, which on the eve paid 23.70% for him, at 23:00 UTC on 03/Oct, was resolved in his favour. 🤝 According to Agência Brasil, he talks of staying silent in the second round; the report has a single source and is included with attribution.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): fourth place, with 2.24% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. PRICE: winner contract closed and resolved at zero, with USD 17.12M cumulative. [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): he backs neither of the two.
fortes: He finished fourth, with 2.24% of the valid votes, ahead of Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.18%.
His contract in the winner book closed with USD 17.12M cumulative, the second largest in the presidential book.
fracos: He is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and his contract in the winner book was resolved at zero.
On the eve the third-place book paid 47.50% for him, and third place went to Augusto Cury.
candidates.analise: Renan Santos finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in fourth, with 2.24% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally, and is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). His contract in the winner book was closed by Polymarket after the first round and resolved at zero, with USD 17.12M cumulative, the second largest in the presidential book, behind Lula's. On the eve the third-place book paid 47.50% for him, at 23:00 UTC on 03/Oct, and it was resolved in favour of Augusto Cury. 🤝 On the night of 04/Oct he said he backs neither of the two in the second round and freed Missão's activists to choose (Gazeta do Povo and Agência Brasil).

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.18% of the valid votes, and Romeu Zema, with 0.27%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. Fernando Haddad did not run for President. PRICE: the three winner contracts were closed and resolved at zero.
candidates.subtitle: The three names outside the leading pack, with the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) final tally (100% of polling sections) and the closing of the winner contracts after the first round.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), eliminated in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with 2.18% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.82M cumulative.
caiado.fortes: He declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in Goiânia on 06/Oct, with governor Daniel Vilela (O Globo and VEJA).
caiado.fracos: He finished fifth, behind Renan Santos, and the PSD decided on neutrality in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (Folha de S.Paulo and Agência Brasil).

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), did not run for President: he ran for governor of São Paulo and lost to Tarcísio de Freitas in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.74M cumulative.
haddad.fortes: The top of his series in the winner contract was 7.60%, on 26/May, measured in the database backup.
haddad.fracos: He was not measured by any national poll in a presidential scenario or in a second-round pairing.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), eliminated in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with 0.27% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.74M cumulative.
zema.fortes: ⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of his voters would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), the largest transfer among the names measured (O Globo).
zema.fracos: He had 0.27% of the valid votes. He declared his vote for Flávio Bolsonaro on 05/Oct, and Novo declared support for him on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital).

candidates.analise: 🗳️ Ronaldo Caiado finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in fifth, with 2.18% of the valid votes, and Romeu Zema had 0.27%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. Fernando Haddad ran for governor of São Paulo, not for President. The three contracts in the winner book were closed by Polymarket and resolved at zero. 🤝 Romeu Zema declared his vote for Flávio Bolsonaro on the night of 05/Oct (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo), and Novo, his party, declared support on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital). Ronaldo Caiado declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in Goiânia on 06/Oct (O Globo and VEJA), even with the PSD neutral in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (Folha de S.Paulo and Agência Brasil).
fortes: Ronaldo Caiado declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 06/Oct (O Globo and VEJA), and Romeu Zema declared his vote for him on 05/Oct, followed by Novo on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital).
⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of Romeu Zema's voters and 42% of Ronaldo Caiado's would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (O Globo).
fracos: The two are out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and the winner contracts of all three names were resolved at zero.
Fernando Haddad did not run for President: he ran for governor of São Paulo and lost to Tarcísio de Freitas in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno).

cruzamento: Third day of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). 💹 In the confirmed reading of 07/Oct, 17:35 BRT, Flávio Bolsonaro rises 0.65pp and Lula falls 1.00pp against the confirmed reading of 06/Oct at 15:05 BRT, published in the previous update, and the gap goes from 68.80pp to 70.45pp. 🗳️ In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally of 05/Oct, with 100% of polling sections, Flávio Bolsonaro had 47.03% of the valid votes and Lula 45.16%. 🤝 Novo declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 07/Oct, after Romeu Zema (G1 and CartaCapital), and ACM Neto announced support for him on the same day (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo). PP and União Brasil, which form the União Progressista federation, announced support on 06/Oct (G1, O Globo and Folha de S.Paulo), and Ronaldo Caiado declared support for him in Goiânia on the same day (O Globo and VEJA). According to VEJA and O Globo, Republicanos is expected to formalize support for Flávio Bolsonaro, with Tarcísio de Freitas in Brasília for that purpose, and VEJA reports that he is aiming to bring in Podemos. MDB is consulting its state branches: the majority favours a vote for Flávio Bolsonaro, according to Folha de S.Paulo, and the party is expected to remain neutral, according to O Globo. Solidariedade is not expected to back him, Paulinho da Força told Gazeta do Povo. Lula said at a meeting with allies on 07/Oct that this year's campaign was the most disorganized he has taken part in since 1989 (Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo), called supporters to the streets on social media (G1) and pressed Flávio Bolsonaro for a position on ending the 6x1 work schedule (Agência Brasil). 🎙️ The broadcasters confirmed four second-round debates: Record on 11/Oct, at 21:00, a pool of 11 outlets with CNN Brasil, SBT and VEJA on 15/Oct, at 20:00, Band on 18/Oct, at 20:00, and TV Globo on 23/Oct (CartaCapital, VEJA and G1). The attendance of the two candidates is not yet confirmed, and according to Gazeta do Povo Flávio Bolsonaro is waiting for Lula's decision to confirm Band. 📺 In decisions released on 07/Oct, the TSE president, Kassio Nunes Marques, kept online videos from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign that associate Lula with Alexandre de Moraes and Lulinha with the so-called Careca do [INSS](/en/glossary#inss), and denied the Lula campaign's requests for removal and for a right of reply (G1 and Gazeta do Povo). 📊 The first second-round national polls are registered with the TSE for 08/Oct (Datafolha and PoderData), 09/Oct (AtlasIntel and Vox Brasil), 10/Oct (Ipespe) and 11/Oct (DataTrends). ⛔ The panel does not attribute price moves to the endorsements or to the schedule: it measures the sides with each one's timestamps.
